text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Super Cassette Vision was released in Japan in 1984 as the successor to Epoch's Cassette Vision console. It used cartridge-based software and competed with the Nintendo Famicom. The system featured improved graphics and a larger game library compared with its predecessor. Titles included Pop & Chips, Elevator Fight, and Comic Circus. Although it achieved some success in Japan, it was unable to compete with Nintendo's growing market presence.
